<details class="nhsuk-details">
<summary class="nhsuk-details__summary"><span class="nhsuk-details__summary-text">Text description of this diagram</span></summary>
<div class="nhsuk-details__text">

A grid with likelihood across the top, from 1 low to 4 very high, and impact down the side, from 4 very high at the top to 1 low at the bottom. Where cells side by side give the same level, they are drawn as one.

- **Impact 4 very high.** Level 4 BCA at every likelihood.
- **Impact 3 high.** Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1, Level 2 Enhanced at 2, and Level 3 Comprehensive at 3 and 4.
- **Impact 2 moderate.** Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1, Level 2 Enhanced at 2 and 3, and Level 3 Comprehensive at 4.
- **Impact 1 low.** Level 1 Standard at likelihood 1 to 3, and Level 2 Enhanced at 4.

The table below gives the same matrix in words.

</details>
